# Finerworks

FinerWorks is an online platform specializing in fine art and photo printing services, offering artists and photographers the ability to order prints and manage their inventory.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/finerworks/.

## Actions

- **Add Images**: Add images to a finerworks library.
- **Get User** (read-only): Retrieve the current user's profile.
- **List Media Types** (read-only): Get available media types.
- **List Product Types** (read-only): List product types.
- **List Shipping Options Multiple** (read-only): List shipping options for multiple orders.
- **List Style Types** (read-only): Get a list of style types.
- **Submit Orders**: Submit up to five new orders.
- **Test My Credentials** (read-only): Test the configured FinerWorks credentials.
- **Update User**: Update various features of a user's account profile.
- **Update File Selection**: Update a user's currently selected image files using the selection key.
